# Express Pro Cleaning Services — full reference

Express Pro Cleaning Services, home of the original Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning, has proudly served homes and businesses throughout Sacramento and the surrounding areas since 1989. What began as a specialty blind and window cleaning business has grown to offer a wide range of residential and commercial cleaning services. The business was founded in 1989; in 1998 it was taken over by a family member and has been family-owned ever since. Owner Anna Piontkevych runs the business day-to-day and handles estimates personally. The team works in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

## Contact
- Phone (call or text): (916) 983-9274
- Email: expressprocleanings@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sat 7:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sun closed
- Service area: Sacramento and communities within about 30 miles — North Highlands, Rio Linda, Citrus Heights, Carmichael, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom
- Estimates: free, flat quotes; supplies and equipment included

## Services (five categories)

### Window Cleaning Services — /services/window-cleaning/
Interior and exterior window cleaning with frames, sills and tracks; blind cleaning in place or taken down and washed; screen cleaning (removed, washed, refitted); screen and blind repairs (re-screening, cords, slats, tilt mechanisms). Single-story, two-story, storefront and office glass.

### House Cleaning Services — /services/house-cleaning/
Deep cleaning; move-in / move-out cleaning; post-construction cleaning; recurring maintenance cleaning (weekly, every-other-week, monthly) with the same team each visit. Carpet cleaning is NOT offered.

### Gutter and Roof Cleaning — /services/gutter-roof-cleaning/
Gutter cleaning with downspouts flushed and debris hauled away; solar panel cleaning with soft brushes and purified water (dirty panels block sunlight from the cells, so cleaning keeps the system producing efficiently); roof debris cleaning (leaves, needles, moss from valleys and eaves).

### Pressure / Soft Washing — /services/pressure-washing/
Pressure washing for driveways, walkways, patios and pavers; low-pressure soft washing for house exteriors, roofs, decks, porches and fences.

### Seasonal Services — /services/seasonal-services/
Christmas light installation with purpose-made clips (customer's lights or supplied LED strands), timers, and January takedown with lights coiled and boxed.
